name: Adversarial design — six weight families, ring critique, mechanical merge, opus synth
description: Bespoke six-family pass (auth: Kevin, chat ask 2026-08-06). Six independent designers — claude-opus-4-8, grok-4.5 (runtime grok), and FOUR workerProfile-borrowed legs (kimi-1, qwen-1, deepseek-dorian, glm-geoff) — each design alone from an IDENTICAL prompt, so diversity is weights, not phrasing. Ring critique (each family critiques exactly one other family's proposal, O(N) not O(N^2)) keeps every proposal adversarially examined without the 30-node pairwise furnace. Fan-in is MECHANICAL (core:merge, on:always) — a partial panel degrades and SAYS SO via missing/present rosters, never dies silently. The opus synthesizer converges designs+critiques into one vetted spec and must record true attendance: KNOWN QUIRK — a FAILED upstream node leaves its {{nodes.*}} template literal unresolved (dependencies/task-graph/src/template.ts:22,35), which core:merge counts as PRESENT, so the synth prompt treats literal-template parts as absent. notify is condense:false because the spec IS the product (ask-resume precedent); a separate notify-fail node on on:failure keeps failed runs loud instead of silent. The three newest profiles (qwen-1, deepseek-dorian, glm-geoff) have never been workerProfile-borrowed before — this run is their shakedown; a dead leg is a finding, not a failure of the panel. Params (ALL REQUIRED — unfilled passes through literally and fails loudly): task, cwd (repo root, designers are fs.read ONLY), context (existing-machinery grounding pasted by the caller), agent (notify target).

Cite file:line for every claim about existing behavior.

Mechanical fan-in (never a model join). on:always edges: a dead leg degrades the panel and is rostered in missing — EXCEPT the known unresolved-literal quirk: a FAILED designer leaves its template literal in parts, which merge counts as present; synth corrects the roster.
Ring critique: grok critiques opus. Fresh session; skips if design-opus failed (default success edge).
Ring critique: opus critiques glm. Ring closes — every proposal examined by exactly one foreign family.
Mechanical fan-in of the six critiques; same unresolved-literal caveat as merge-designs.

Opus adjudicator converges 6 designs + 6 critiques into one vetted spec. Independence dies here BY DESIGN — the product is a single spec; generation and critique already spent the independence budget.
